description: The KINP world model (koine/specs/identity.md §5) and the ratified explicit @world(W) context argument (§11 decision 3). Worlds form an inheritance chain — pinakes:world:consensus-reality ← insimul:world:<w> (editor canon) ← insimul:world:<w>#save-<id> (a playthrough) — and reasoning is relative to a world, resolving parent facts unless the world overrides them. The '#' of §5's playthrough spelling is percent-encoded per §3.1, so a playthrough's local id is '<w>%23save-<id>'. '@world' is a QUOTED atom used as a functor: '@' is a symbolic character, so a bare @world(W) would need a custom prefix operator, and a :- op/3 directive does not survive a KB snapshot. The rules in each kb mirror packages/core/src/identity/world-predicates.ts verbatim; a native engine consults the same clauses. Bindings stay scalar — every id/3 column is projected through id_local/2 (see README § 'KINP identifiers in the corpus').

cases.name: world-chain-ancestors
kb: world_parent(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), id(world, insimul, alderforest)).
world_parent(id(world, insimul, alderforest), id(world, pinakes, 'consensus-reality')).
world_ancestor(W, P) :- world_parent(W, P).
world_ancestor(W, A) :- world_parent(W, M), world_ancestor(M, A).
id_local(id(_, _, L), L).
playthrough_ancestor(L) :- world_ancestor(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), A), id_local(A, L).

cases.name: world-scope-is-the-world-then-its-ancestors
kb: world_parent(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), id(world, insimul, alderforest)).
world_parent(id(world, insimul, alderforest), id(world, pinakes, 'consensus-reality')).
world_ancestor(W, P) :- world_parent(W, P).
world_ancestor(W, A) :- world_parent(W, M), world_ancestor(M, A).
world_scope(W, W).
world_scope(W, A) :- world_ancestor(W, A).
id_local(id(_, _, L), L).
scope(L) :- world_scope(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), S), id_local(S, L).

cases.name: playthrough-inherits-canon-facts
kb: world_parent(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), id(world, insimul, alderforest)).
claim(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), garrisons, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', northkeep), '@world'(id(world, insimul, alderforest))).
claim_at(W, S, P, O) :- claim(S, P, O, '@world'(W)).
claim_defined(W, S, P) :- claim(S, P, _, '@world'(W)).
world_resolve(W, S, P, O) :- claim_at(W, S, P, O).
world_resolve(W, S, P, O) :- world_parent(W, Parent), world_resolve(Parent, S, P, O), \+ claim_defined(W, S, P).
holds(S, P, O, '@world'(W)) :- world_resolve(W, S, P, O).
id_local(id(_, _, L), L).
renaud_holds(W, P, L) :- holds(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), P, O, '@world'(W)), id_local(O, L).

cases.name: holds-at-reports-the-world-a-resolved-fact-came-from
kb: world_parent(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), id(world, insimul, alderforest)).
claim(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), garrisons, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', northkeep), '@world'(id(world, insimul, alderforest))).
claim(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), commands, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'army-of-ash'), '@world'(id(world, insimul, alderforest))).
claim(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), garrisons, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'northkeep-ruins'), '@world'(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'))).
claim_at(W, S, P, O) :- claim(S, P, O, '@world'(W)).
claim_defined(W, S, P) :- claim(S, P, _, '@world'(W)).
world_resolve_at(W, S, P, O, W) :- claim_at(W, S, P, O).
world_resolve_at(W, S, P, O, Source) :- world_parent(W, Parent), world_resolve_at(Parent, S, P, O, Source), \+ claim_defined(W, S, P).
holds_at(S, P, O, '@world'(W), Source) :- world_resolve_at(W, S, P, O, Source).
id_local(id(_, _, L), L).
source_of(P, SL) :- holds_at(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), P, _, '@world'(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f')), Source), id_local(Source, SL).

cases.name: overrides-is-checkable
kb: world_parent(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), id(world, insimul, alderforest)).
claim(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), garrisons, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', northkeep), '@world'(id(world, insimul, alderforest))).
claim(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), commands, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'army-of-ash'), '@world'(id(world, insimul, alderforest))).
claim(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), garrisons, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'northkeep-ruins'), '@world'(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'))).
claim_defined(W, S, P) :- claim(S, P, _, '@world'(W)).
world_defines(W, S, P) :- claim_defined(W, S, P).
world_defines(W, S, P) :- world_parent(W, Parent), world_defines(Parent, S, P).
overrides(W, S, P) :- claim_defined(W, S, P), world_parent(W, Parent), world_defines(Parent, S, P).
overridden(P) :- overrides(id(world, insimul, 'alderforest%23save-7f'), id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), P).
